context: Created 2026-11-03 from the approved capture ~/.todo-db/finding-drafts/benchbox/2026-11-02-databend-release-uat-coverage.md (owner decision 2026-11-02 during 0.5.0rc3 release UAT).
description:
The owner approved excluding Databend from the 0.5.0rc3 release UAT and creating this follow-up. Databend remains an available adapter; the exclusion removes release certification, not the adapter.

Evidence: GitHub Actions run 41384413935 at commit 5bad4ba5a2, artifact dryrun-stage3-olap (local copy ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/release-uat-dryrun-9/art/dryrun-stage3-olap). Its stage-3 olap shard reports 14 Databend cells exiting without JSON, four failing primitives cells, and TPC-Havoc timing out after 1200 s at scale 0.01. Doris and SingleStore passed in the same shard.

The exclusion landed in #3902: tests/uat/configs/release-gate-03-docker-oltp.yaml excludes databend (floor 105 of 132 eligible pairs) and the release-v2.yml olap shard runs doris,singlestore.
